Chapter 632: Chapter 46: No Matter How Strong The Galaxy Master Is, Can He Really Kill Us All? (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 632: Chapter 46: No matter how strong the Galaxy Master is, can he really kill us all? (5000 words, please subscribe)

The Mysterious Emperor Lineage’s three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills—

Incorporate attack, defense, and escape, appearing impeccable,

But the premise is that one must be able to cultivate them.

But to cultivate them? Is it that easy?

All things in the world subtly maintain a certain stable balance,

Special life forms with terrifying talents have low reproductive capabilities,

...

And those unique special life forms have no reproductive capabilities at all.

The countless citizens of human civilization are on average the bottom tier among the peak clans,

Yet their reproductive capability is described as defying the heavens.

This is a type of balance.

Or rather, it’s a ‘restriction’.

The secret techniques are the same, the three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Mysterious Emperor Lineage, each one is considered inconceivable.

However, to cultivate them, or rather to get started, is far more difficult than one might imagine.

If Lin Yuan were a tier 11 life form, comprehended the Complete Space Rules, Rule of Time, then such quick mastery of the secret technique could perhaps be barely explained.

After all, with a higher view, one learns faster whatever the realm.

But Lin Yuan was only Ninth Rank, a Ninth Rank life, and he had cultivated the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” to its first stage in just a few years?

“This young one, with a real breath of not more than four thousand years, has opened up so many Spatial Layers, now?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette fell silent.

According to Lin Yuan’s current cultivation speed, at most in five thousand years, he would be able to cultivate the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” to the third stage.

By then, Lin Yuan’s casual strike would emit a blow four times the power of his own limit,

and would keep this state “permanent”.

“In my Mysterious Emperor Lineage, while His Majesty was still here, the fastest record to cultivate the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ to the third stage was seven thousand three hundred ninety-four years, and that person was a tier 11 life.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette thought to himself,

A Ninth Rank life cultivating the secret technique faster than a tier 11 life? This was something he had never imagined.

A Ninth Rank and tier 11 life, nearly could not be considered the same species,

The gap between them was like a chasm, a tier 11 life could see through the essence in one glance, a Ninth Rank might take ten thousand years to understand.

“Maybe not necessarily.”

“Having so smoothly cultivated the first stage, does not guarantee the second stage, let alone the third stage, will be as smooth.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette took a deep breath, suddenly laughed, “What am I worrying about, His Majesty’s successor should naturally have an exorbitant talent. If not, how could he catch up to His Majesty’s pace?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette shook his head slightly, at this point, he was too lazy to understand why Lin Yuan’s speed in cultivating the secret technique was so fast, as it was meaningless.

Just then.

The countless Spatial Layers outside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, suddenly began to ripple with waves.

“Hmm?”

“Those Twelfth-Rank life forms, are they trying to lock onto the location of the Secret Realm again?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette glanced at it, sneered, “Even if His Majesty has disappeared for dozens of Cosmic Eras, but you Twelfth-Rank who have not experienced a complete Cosmic annihilation, trying to break through His Majesty’s methods is just wishful thinking.”

…

In the deep depths of the vast Spatial Layers.

Several massive beings stood there.

Just by standing there, they made many Spatial Layers give way, forming a domain entirely their own, within which space and time were toys to be tampered with at will.

“This Xuanhuang Secret Realm, exactly where is it? I’m becoming more and more curious about its former owner, that ‘Emperor’.”

A being with twenty-four pairs of wings on its back spoke with a grand voice, his tone brimming with curiosity.

“What shall we do now, still unable to lock onto the location of the Secret Realm?” Another enormous being, miles in size, spoke, his voice disturbing the time and space of the area.

“What can we do? Go back the way we came!” The third towering figure turned around and disappeared into the distance with one step.

“Hmph!” The second towering figure’s expression remained calm, each time the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened, Supreme Beings would come and try to lock the location coordinates.

But without exception, all had failed.

At the level of Supreme Beings, most treasures, weapons, and secret techniques in the world were of little use to them, but the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was different.

Leaving the rest aside, the mere fact of its hiding method was enough to alarm many Supreme Beings.

More so, all Supreme Beings shared a common thought, that inside the Secret Realm, there must be a great secret or a great treasure.

Otherwise, why would great efforts be made to hide the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, if not for something?

Before long.

The few Supreme Beings standing here all disappeared, and the spacetime returned to stability.

…

Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan circulated the “Mysterious Yellow Strike”, found that the speed of refining the Core of the Secret Realm greatly increased, and his heart was instantly delighted.

Among the three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Mysterious Emperor Lineage, the “Mysterious Yellow Strike”, ranked as an attack secret technique, isn’t quite accurate; it is more like a ‘passive’ secret technique, applicable in any aspect.

Just like now, Lin Yuan used the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” to speed up the refining of the Core of the Secret Realm, though refining has nothing to do with attacking.

“Is this the feeling of control?”

As Lin Yuan’s progress in refining the Core of the Secret Realm increased, his control over the Secret Realm also elevated.

Now Lin Yuan could clearly feel every little detail of the peripheral regions of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, those hidden Ninth Rank Different Species in some corners, and the communications among these Ninth Rank Different Species.

None escaped Lin Yuan’s perception.

Of course, the peripheral region here refers to the peripheral region of the continent where these outsiders had arrived.

As for the other two continents, they would gradually come under Lin Yuan’s full control as he continued refining the Core of the Secret Realm.
